primary_pack.instructions: Which OpenAgents capability pack is the primary fit for this user request?

criteria.general: General conversation, Q&A, writing, brainstorming, or everyday help with no workspace tools needed
criteria.knowledge: Searching or citing documentation, books, transcripts, notes, or the shared knowledge base (NIP-KB)
criteria.coder: Software engineering: reading, editing, debugging, testing, reviewing, or refactoring code in a repository
criteria.wallet: Bitcoin or Lightning wallet: checking balances, paying/creating BOLT11 invoices, sats, or spending approvals
criteria.metaverse: OpenAgents Metaverse, 3D scenes, realms, Everglade, or GameBuilder authoring
criteria.cli: Terminal, shell, CLI commands, tmux sessions, or host process inspection
criteria.gym: Model evaluation, gBench, Terminal-Bench, LoRA training, or harness hillclimbing in the Gym
criteria.capability_author: Authoring, creating, or extending a new OpenAgents capability, skill, tool, or plugin

compute_tier.instructions: Which compute tier should run this turn?

criteria.local_inkling: Local Inkling 2 Mini ($0, fast on-device): greetings, everyday Q&A, quick lookups, or small simple edits
criteria.cloud_fast: Cloud Fast (Gemini 4 Neon medium): standard coding, multi-file lookups, knowledge synthesis, or moderate tasks
criteria.cloud_deep: Cloud Deep (Gemini 4 Neon high): hard debugging, architecture, multi-file refactors, or complex reasoning
criteria.remote_station: Remote Station: work that specifically requires a connected remote machine (GPU, Linux build box, or remote repo)

explicit_delegate.instructions: Did the user explicitly instruct delegating this task to an external coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor)? Only a direct instruction counts.

criteria.none: No external CLI requested: OpenAgents handles the task natively
criteria.claude: The user explicitly asks to delegate to Claude Code / Claude (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku)
criteria.codex: The user explicitly asks to delegate to Codex / OpenAI GPT
criteria.antigravity: The user explicitly asks to delegate to Antigravity / AGY
criteria.cursor: The user explicitly asks to delegate to Cursor

difficulty.instructions: How hard is the task to do well?
criteria: Easy: a short answer or a small edit
Moderate: a few files or steps
Hard: many files, debugging or design
Very hard: a long, open-ended or risky task

effort.instructions: How much reasoning effort should the model spend?

criteria.high: High: careful reasoning for hard problems

missing_capability.instructions: Does the user ask to interact with a third-party external app, SaaS service, or smart-home integration (such as Slack, Discord, Gmail, Google Calendar, Spotify, Notion, Linear, Jira, HomeKit, Philips Hue) that is NOT covered by OpenAgents' 8 built-in capability packs (general chat, knowledge base/docs/books/transcripts, software coding/git/delegates, Bitcoin/Lightning wallet/sats/invoices, Metaverse/Everglade/GameBuilder 3D realms, CLI/terminal/tmux/host, Gym/gBench/LoRA/evals, and authoring new OpenAgents skills/plugins)?

criteria.true_description: Yes, it requires a third-party external app or integration outside the 8 built-in packs
criteria.false_description: No, one of the 8 built-in OpenAgents capability packs (including wallet, metaverse, coder, knowledge, cli, gym, capability_author, general) handles it

missing_capability_kind.instructions: Only if missing_capability is yes (a third-party external app outside the 8 built-in OpenAgents packs), what kind of external integration is requested? Choose none whenever any built-in pack (general, knowledge, coder, wallet, metaverse, cli, gym, capability_author) covers it.

criteria.none: None: the installed OpenAgents capability packs can handle this request
criteria.messaging_integration: Messaging integration not built in (e.g. Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, SMS)
criteria.calendar_email: Calendar or email integration not built in (e.g. Google Calendar, Gmail, Outlook)
criteria.media_smart_home: Media or smart-home control not built in (e.g. Spotify, Apple Music, HomeKit, Philips Hue)
criteria.web_automation: External web app / SaaS automation not built in (e.g. Notion, Linear, Jira, Salesforce, Stripe)
criteria.custom_api_tool: Custom external API or bespoke tool not covered by built-in packs
